content.text:
At Salt & Ember, we return to the primary elements of the kitchen: the raw power of the flame and the precision of the mineral.

Our hearth is the heart of the room. We utilize live fire not as a novelty, but as a craft—using smoke and char to reveal the character of seasonal Texas ingredients. Every dish is a study in restraint, finished with hand-harvested salts and served in a space designed for the unhurried.

We invite you to sit close to the fire and stay a while.

Chef Anthony Russo brings a deep respect for ingredients and a fearless love of fire to every plate that leaves the kitchen.

Known for his bold flavors and disciplined technique, Chef Russo’s cooking is rooted in simplicity done exceptionally well: quality sourcing, honest preparation, and that unmistakable edge you only get from open flame.

You’ll find his influence across the menu—from rich, slow-cooked proteins to bright, herb-forward finishes—each dish designed to feel both comforting and exciting.
